name: R-11 revision-5 first 24-hour bg-host embedding window: INCONCLUSIVE
command: Read dbos.workflow_status rows for name='embedBackfill' in the missing interval; group by status and recovery_attempts; inspect graceful-shutdown-recovery-credit.ts before inferring attempt counts
Parse starts, exclusions, errorClass, and per-target completion counts as specified in method; compare with the committed baseline
summary: The first revision-5 24-hour window cannot be graded in full: its first 3h48m20s and the start-target snapshot are absent. Observed eligible sweeps have 112 error-like lines in 205 sweeps versus baseline 74 in 266. DBOS recovery_attempts cannot bound the missing interval because graceful restarts decrement the counter. Continuous-engine coverage and the full-window error rate remain unknown; no pass is claimed.

window.coverageBasis: Both journalctl --list-boots and journalctl --user --list-boots begin with boot d02155aeac354b23898e7325f799da48 at 2026-10-02 00:41:49 EDT; journalctl --user returned zero lines for the missing interval. No full-window journal source was found.

runtime.continuousBuildCoverage: unknown because the start of the window has no retained journal

method.source: R-11 rubric revision 5; errorClass comes from r11-window-analysis.json
method.sweepBoundary: Each sweep starts at one [embed-backfill] sweep starting line and ends at the next such line or window end.
method.excludedSweeps: A sweep is excluded if it overlaps a sidecar Stopping/Starting event or contains a sidecar-reported database time-budget error.
method.parse: Parse the leading ISO timestamp and [embed-backfill] message from short-iso-precise journal lines. Count error-like messages only within eligible sweeps.

identityRedaction.method: scripts/lib/identity-leak-patterns.mjs redactIdentityLeaks; journal hostname field becomes buildhost
identityRedaction.rawPreserved: private evidence archive plus historical git object

missingIntervalAttemptAccounting.source: Read-only dev:pg_query of dbos.workflow_status where name='embedBackfill' and created_at falls in this interval, measured 2026-10-03T01:22Z
missingIntervalAttemptAccounting.workflowStatus: All 45 rows have status SUCCESS; 43 have recovery_attempts=1 and 2 have recovery_attempts=2.
missingIntervalAttemptAccounting.counterLimitation: This is not an execution upper bound. packages/operator-core/lib/dbos/graceful-shutdown-recovery-credit.ts decrements recovery_attempts for in-flight PENDING workflows during a graceful restart; its integration test proves a workflow can execute repeatedly while the retained counter stays at 1. Therefore 1+the retained value can undercount actual executions.
missingIntervalAttemptAccounting.callerCheck: The bg-host source calls runEmbedBackfillOnce once in embedBackfillTick, which calls _runSweepLogged once; repository search found no other bg-host caller. This limits sweeps per execution but not the number of credited executions.
missingIntervalAttemptAccounting.comparison: The observed segment's 112/205=0.5463414634 exceeds baseline 74/266=0.2781954887. The full-window ratio cannot be bounded by the retained recovery counter; no conclusion that the full-window rate falsifier fires follows from these counts.
missingIntervalAttemptAccounting.limitations: The missing journal prevents counting actual attempts, exclusions, and error lines. The DBOS rows establish workflow presence only; recovery credits make their final counters unsuitable as an attempt census.

distinctObservedTemplates: a sweep has held the latch
formatStringCheck.result: all five templates occur in pre-extraction source; only the first three remain in eligible sweeps after rev5 exclusions

assertions.evidence: The first 13,700 seconds of the required window have no retained journal records.
Ten targets embedded rows in the observed portion, but there is no start-of-window missing-row snapshot, so the required proof is incomplete.
Every observed error-like template was found at 9a9473af95.

Observed segment 112/205 exceeds baseline 74/266, but missing-interval eligible sweep and error counts are unknown. DBOS recovery credit invalidates a 92-attempt cap, so the full-window falsifier cannot be decided.

limitations: No start-of-window per-target missing-row snapshot is available; aggregate embedding counts cannot prove that each row missing at the start was embedded.
The absent early-window sweeps prevent an exact full-window ratio; the DBOS recovery_attempts counter cannot upper-bound attempts because graceful restarts can credit them back.
Longer observed sweep durations accompany more budget-expired and latch-skip lines; this is correlation, not an established cause of the latency change.
